poster_cards.html:
Advancing Local Therapy Technologies: Radiotherapy & Other Ablative Techniques

(P 01) SYNTHETIC COHORT STUDY OF LOCAL ABLATIVE RADIOTHERAPY IN SOFT TISSUE SARCOMA

Author(s)

  • Alex R. Morgan, MD

    Professor
    Northbridge Cancer Institute
    Boston, Massachusetts, United States

Co-Author(s)

  • Dana K. Patel, MD

    Northbridge Cancer Institute
    Boston, Massachusetts, United States

Poster Presenter(s)

  • Evan T. Brooks, MD (he/him/his)

    Associate Professor
    Mountain View Cancer Center
    Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

Objective: Stereotactic Body Radiotherapy (SBRT) plus sunitinib was evaluated in a synthetic phase 2 cohort (NCT09990001) of KIT-mutant gastrointestinal stromal tumor.
Methods: Eligible patients (n=40) received sunitinib 37.5 mg daily with ablative radiotherapy.
Results: As of 2026-05-01, the ORR was 35.0% (14/40; 95% CI, 20.6-51.7) and median PFS was 8.4 months (95% CI, 5.2-11.9).

Translational Tumor Biology

(P 02) PRECLINICAL PAZOPANIB ACTIVITY IN SYNOVIAL SARCOMA SPHEROID MODELS

Author(s)

  • Clara S. Vance, PhD

    Principal Scientist
    Central Biomedical Institute
    Toronto, Ontario, Canada

Objective: Evaluate pazopanib sensitivity in SS18::SSX1 fusion synovial sarcoma models.
Methods: Patient-derived spheroids were exposed to pazopanib across dose gradients.
Results: Viability declined by 62% at 72 hours.
Conclusion: Our results uncover synthetic dependency pathways in fusion-driven sarcoma.
Clara S. Vance, PhD: Research grant from Apex BioLabs Inc.

Objective: Assess safety and activity of lenvatinib plus ifosfamide in recurrent osteosarcoma.
Methods: Enrollment of 36 patients is ongoing across four centers.
